# Coffee Cream Cake

## Ingredients

- 1/2 cupful butter
- 1 cupful sugar
- 1/2 cupful milk
- 1/2 cupful cornstarch
- 1 1/4 cupfuls flour
- 1/2 teaspoonful cream tartar
- pinch of soda
- 3 egg whites, stiffly beaten
- 1 cupful milk (for filling)
- 1 cupful strong coffee (for filling)
- 1 cupful sugar (for filling)

## Instructions

1. Cream together half a cupful of butter and a cupful of sugar.
2. Add half a cupful of milk and sift in half a cupful of cornstarch, one and one-fourth cupfuls of flour, half a teaspoonful of cream tartar and a pinch of soda.
3. Fold in the stiffly beaten whites of three eggs.
4. Bake in buttered layer-cake tins for half an hour.
5. Cook in a double-boiler one cupful of milk, one cupful of strong coffee, and a cupful of sugar.
6. Thicken with the [text cuts off]
